{{Quote|Second hop, Rafana was flying lead, wearing that fancy bucket of his with the integrated HUD. The flash scrambled the HUD, filling his vision with random characters, and he got stitched by a Vulture.|[[Jorn Kulish]], on his experiences during the battle over Ongary IX|<ref name="rote" />}}
'''Rafana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Foxfire Squadron]] within the [[Ividal Sector Forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, Foxfire Squadron was deployed to support the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in an [[Attack on Ongary IX|engagement]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] over the [[Planet|world]] [[Ongary IX]]. During the battle, Foxfire Squadron were deployed as [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to fire [[burrowing plasma charge]]s against Separatist positions entrenched inside fortified [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. However, the flash from the explosion of the charges was so bright that it scrambled the [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD display]] in Rafana's [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], and while he was distracted he was shot down and [[Death|killed]] by a Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]].<ref name="rote" />
